spans.s:
mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Unmanifested, unapparent.
E.
अ neg. प्रकट evident.

mfn. (-म्पः-म्पा-म्पं)
1 Unshaken, literally or figuratively, firm, steady.
2 Unanswered, unrefuted.
E.
अ neg. प्रकम्प trembling.

n. (-ता)
1 Firmness, stability.
2 Unanswerableness.
E.
तल् added to the preceding, also with त्व, अप्रकम्पत्व.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Not exceeded, not more than.
2 Unsurpassed.
E.
अ neg. प्रकर्षित bettered, exceeded.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Hidden, private, not public or displayed, not manifest or evident.
E.
अ neg. प्रकाश light.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Not manifested, undivulged, unrevealed, not evident or public.
E.
अ neg. प्रकाशित manifested.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unusual, uncommon, occasional or incidental to.
E.
अ neg. प्र before कृत made.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Special, particular, not common or generic.
2 Not vulgar, (especially as dialect or speech.)
E.
अ neg. प्राकृत common, vulgar.

f. (-तिः)
1 Accidental property or nature, not the inherent or inseparable property.
2 Spiritual being.
E.
अ neg. प्रकृति nature or matter.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Low, vile.
m. (-ष्टः)
A crow.
E.
अ neg. प्रकृष्ट excellent.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Dull, obtuse.
2 Bland, mild.
E.
अ neg. प्रखर sharp.

mfn. (-ल्मः-ल्मा-ल्मं)
Modest, unassuming.
E.
अ neg. प्रगल्भ arrogant.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Confounded, perplexed.
E.
अ neg. प्रगुण direct.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Little, few.
E.
अ neg. प्रचुर much.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Undesired, not bidden or commanded.
2 Undeclared, not said.
3 Not promised.
4 Unasked, declared.
E.
अ neg. प्रचोदित directed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Observing, following, not fallen or deviating from.
E.
अ neg. प्रच्युत fallen.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Childless, without progeny.
2 Unpeopled, destitute of subjects.
E.
अ neg. प्रजा offspring.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Childless.
f. (-ता)
A barren woman.
E.
अ neg. प्रजात generated.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unconsecrated, profane, common.
E.
अ neg. प्रणीत sacred.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Not to be turned away.
E.
अ neg. प्रणोद्य to be dismissed.

mfn. (-र्क्यः-र्क्या-र्क्यं)
Not to be discussed, incomprehensible by reason.
E.
अ neg. प्रतर्क्य to be investigated.

m. (-पः)
1 Meanness, want of dignity.
2 Dulness, want of brilliancy.
E.
अ neg. प्रताप splendor.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Trusted, confidential.
2 One who does not requite or retaliate.
E.
अ neg. प्रति again, कर who does.

m. (-रः)
1 Non-requital, non-acquittal.
2 Non-retaliation.
3 Not remedying.
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Helpless, defenceless.
2 Irremediable.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिकार rendering again or the like.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Unresisting, defenceless.
2 Irremediable.
m. (रः)
1 Non-retaliation.
2 Want of remedy or relief.
E.
अ neg. प्रतीकार counteracting.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
Not to be taken, unacceptable.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिग्राह्य to be taken.

mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
Favourable, friendly.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिघ adverse.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
Not to be bartered or exchanged.
E.
अ not, प्रति again, पण्य to be sold.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Non-ascertainment.
2 Non-performance, failure.
3 Neglecting. disregard.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिपत्ति effecting.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1

Unascertained.
2

Unaccomplished.
3 Neglected.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिपन्न effected.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
1 Modest, bashful.
2 Confounded, perplexed.
3 Unreflected, (as an image.)
E.
अ neg. प्रतिभा light, reflexion.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Unequalled, incomparable.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिमा similitude.

m. (-त्नः)
Natural or spontaneous state or condition.
E.
अ neg. प्रतियत्न fabrication.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वा-र्व्वं)
Natural, not made or artificial.
E.
अ neg. प्रतियत्न fabrication.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
1 Unobstructed, undisputed.
2 Absolute, direct, (as inheritance,) not collateral or presumptive.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिबन्ध obstacle.

n. (-थं)
1 A march or procession.
2 The Sāma

Veda.
3

Auspicious, well, right.
m. (थः)
A warrior.
E.
अ neg. प्रति against, रथ a car.

mfn. (पः-पा-पी-पं)
Unequalled, incomparable.
E.
अ neg. प्रति against, रूप kind, form.

f. (-था)
Unanswerable or incomparable discourse.
E.
अप्रतिरूप, and कथा speech.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unimpeded, unobstructed.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिकारित hindered.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Natural, unartificial.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिविधान fabrication.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्टं)
1 Infamous, disreputable.
2 Thrown away, unprofitable.
3 Undecided, fluctuating.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिष्ठा credit, &c.

Unconsecrated.
2

Obscure, uncelebrated.
3 Unsettled, unfixed.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिष्ठित celebrated &c.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Unprohibited, unforbidden.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिषिद्ध forbidden.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unaffected, uninjured, unimpaired.
2 Not disappointed.
3 Unobstructed, uninterrupted.
E.
अ neg. प्रतिहत hurt.

f. (-तिः)
Mistrust, want of confidence.
E.
अ neg. प्रतीति faith.

m. (-लः)
Necessity, want.
E.
अ neg. प्रतुल sufficiency.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Invisible, imperceptible, not present.
E.
अ neg. प्रत्यक्ष present.

m. (-यः)
Doubt, distrust, disbelief.
E.
अ neg. प्रत्यय trust.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Doubtful, mistrusting, sceptical.
E.
अप्रत्यय and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Assented to, uncontradicted, unrefuted.
E.
अ neg. प्रत्याख्यात denied.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not to be contradicted, undeniable.
E.
अ neg. प्रत्याख्येय deniable.

Unpublished.
2

Unnoted, unknown.
E.
अ neg. प्रथित celebrated.

n. (-नं)
Subordinate, secondary.
E.
अ neg. प्रधान principal: (always neuter.)

f. (-ता)
Inferiority, subordination.
E.
तल् added to the last, also with त्व, अप्रधानत्वं.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Weak, inefficacious.
E.
अ neg. प्रबल potent.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
1 Dull, obscure.
2 Mean.
E.
अ neg. प्रभा radiance.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Insufficient, inadequate.
E.
अ neg. प्र before भूत been.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Careful, attentive, vigilant.
E.
अ neg. प्रमत्त careless.

m. (-दः)
Care, vigilance.
E.
अ neg. प्रमाद carelessness.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Careful, cautious, steady.
E.
अप्रमाद and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unbounded, unmeasured.
E.
अ neg. प्रमित measured.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Unbounded, immeasurable.
E.
अ neg. प्रमेय measurable.

m. (-त्नः)
Indifference, laziness.
mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं)
Indifferent, apathetic, making no effort.
E.
अ neg. प्रयत्न energy.

mfn. (-म्वः-म्वा-म्वं)
Quick, expeditious.
E.
अ neg. प्रलम्ब slow.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Abstaining from action, inert.
2 Not exciting to action.
E.
अ neg. प्रवर्त्तक what excites.

n. (-नं)
1 Refraining from, not engaging in.
2 Not exciting to.
E.
अ neg. प्र before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Unskilful.
E.
अ neg. प्रवीण skilful.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Abstaining from action, inertion.
2

Nonexcitement.
3

(In Medicine) Suppression of the natural evacuations, constipation, ischury, &c.
E.
अ neg. प्रवृत्ति active exertion.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Moderate, temperate.
E.
अ neg. प्रशक्त intent or fond of.

f. (-क्तिः)
Moderation.
mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति)
Moderate, temperate.
E.
अ neg. प्रशक्ति addiction to any thing.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Bad, worthless.
E.
अ neg. प्रशस्त excellent.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Turbid, muddy.
2 Displeased, dissatisfied, unfavourable.
E.
अ neg. प्रसन्न pleased.

m. (-दः)
Disfavour, disapprobation.
E.
अ neg. प्रसाद favour.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
1 Not to be propitiated.
2 Unappeasable, implacable.
E.
अ neg. प्र before षद to go, यत् aff.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Unusual, uncommon.
2 Uncelebrated.
E.
अ neg. प्रसिद्ध famous.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Not having offspring, barren, childless.
E.
अ neg. प्रसूत bearing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Uncommenced, not begun.
2 Unconnected with, unattached to.
3 Uncommon, unusual.
4 Unpraised, not celebrated.
5 Confounded, not prompt.
E.
अ neg. प्र before ष्टु to praise, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unhurt, intact.
2 Untilled, waste, fallow.
E.
अ neg. प्रहत broken.

mfn. (-ग्र्यः-ग्र्या-ग्र्यं)
Secondary, subordinate.
E.
अ neg. प्राग्र्य principal.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Modern, recent.
E.
अ neg. प्राचीन old.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Unlearned, ignorant.
2 Unconscious, unwitting.
E.
अ neg. प्राज्ञ who knows.

f. (-ता)
1 Unconsciousness.
2 Ignorance.
E.
तल् added to the last, also with त्व, अप्राज्ञत्वं.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Lifeless, inanimate.
m. (-णः)
Death.
E.
अ neg. प्राण life.

mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि)
Lifeless, inanimate.
E.
अप्राण and इनि aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1

Unobtained.
2

Unarrived.
E.
अ neg. प्राप्त acquired.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Inopportune, out of season.
2 Under age.
E.
अप्राप्त, and काल time.

m. (-रः)
A minor.
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Under age, not of years to engage in law or public business.
E.
अ neg. प्राप्त attained, व्यवहार legal affairs.

f. (-प्तिः)
Non-attainment, non-acquisition.
E.
अ neg. प्राप्ति acquisition.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Unobtainable, unattainable.
ind.
Not having obtained.
E.
अ neg. प्राथ future or past part.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Unauthentic, unauthoritative.
E.
अ neg. प्रामाणिक of authority.

n. (-ण्यं)
Absence, or insufficiency of proof or authority.
E.
अ neg. प्रामाण्य proof.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Uncovered, unclothed.
E.
अ neg. प्रावृत covered.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Disliked, disagreeable.
2 Unkind, unfriendly.
m. (-यः)
A foe, an enemy.
f. (-या)
A sort of skeat fish, (Silurus pungentissimus.)
E.
अ neg. प्रिय beloved.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Unfriendly, ill-disposed.
2 Disagreeable.
E.
अप्रिय, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
One who speaks harshly or unkindly.
E.
अ neg. प्रियम्वद kind spoken.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Speaking unkindly.
E.
अप्रिय, and वादिन् who speaks; also अप्रियभाषिन, &c.

f. (-तिः)
1 Dislike, aversion.
2 Unfriendliness, enmity.
E.
अ neg. प्रीति love.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Unkind, adverse.
2 Disagreeable, offensive.
E.
अप्रीति and कर what makes.

n. (-म)
Dislike, aversion.
E.
अ neg. प्रेमन् affection.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Timid, gentle.
2 Immature.
f. (-ढा)
An unmarried girl, or one very recently married, and not come to womanhood.
E.
अ neg. प्रोढ arrogant.

n. (-नं)
Civility upon receiving or parting with a visitor, welcome, adieu, &c.
E.
आङ्, प्रच्छ to ask, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-दं)
A dress reaching to the feet.
E.
आङ् and प्र before पद a foot.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
A dress reaching from the shoulders to the feet.
E.
आङ् and प्र prefixed to पद a foot, ख aff.

n. (-कं)
See the preceding.
E.
कन् added.
